_meta.description: MirageSpider's envelope-wrapped sandbox telemetry (spider.observation, Step 5) plus, elsewhere, mirage-audit for spider.tamper (routed to the audit stream, not here — see subjects.py and ADR-0015). Appendix E names this 'Spider telemetry, case-tagged'; case-tagging comes from the shared envelope's case_id field (Appendix C), populated once Stage 2's case machinery (Step 6/7) exists — a null case_id is valid and expected before then.
